_comment: HAND-WRITTEN FIXTURE. Modeled after PostgreSQL 16 EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON). Triggers 'seq_scan_filtered'. To generate a real plan on local Postgres: CREATE TABLE orders (id serial primary key, status text, created_at date); INSERT INTO orders SELECT g, CASE WHEN g % 20 = 0 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'completed' END, CURRENT_DATE - (g % 365) FROM generate_series(1, 100000) g; EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01';
